description.zh:
是否允许实例TDE密钥在检测到KMS密钥版本变更时，于轮转周期后最近的运维时间进行自动轮转。仅自定义密钥支持该参数。
- **true**：允许
- **false**：不允许
> 仅当数据库引擎为PostgreSQL兼容或Oracle语法兼容时，支持该参数。
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically rotate the TDE key of the instance during the next O\&M window after a new version of the KMS key is available. This parameter is valid only for custom keys.

- **true**

- **false**

> This parameter is supported only when the database engine is compatible with PostgreSQL or Oracle.

description.zh:
是否开启自动加密所有新建的表。取值：

- **ON**：开启

- **OFF**：关闭

> 仅当数据库引擎为MySQL兼容时，该参数生效。
description.en:
Specifies whether to automatically encrypt all new tables. Valid values:

- **ON**

- **OFF**

> This parameter is valid only when the database engine is compatible with MySQL.
The ID of the custom key.

description.zh: 角色的全局资源描述符，用来指定具体角色。详情请参见[RAM角色概览](~~93689~~)。
description.en: The Global Resource Descriptor of the role. You can use this parameter to specify a role. For more information, see [Overview of RAM roles](~~93689~~).
The TDE status. Set the value to **Enable**.

descriptions.zh:
>*  该操作需要先开通KMS。具体操作请参见[购买专属KMS实例](~~153781~~)。
>* TDE加密开启后无法关闭。
descriptions.en:
> - You must activate Key Management Service (KMS) before you perform this operation. For more information, see [Purchase a dedicated KMS instance](~~153781~~).
>
> - You cannot disable transparent data encryption (TDE) after you enable it.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-db-cluster-tde --db-cluster-id pc-000000000000 --tde-status Enable --role-arn acs:ram::140692600000:role/aliyunrdsinstanceencryptiondefaultrole --encryption-key 749c1df7-0000-0000-0000-000000000 --encrypt-new-tables ON --enable-automatic-rotation false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb ModifyDBClusterTDE --region cn-hangzhou --TDEStatus Enable --EncryptNewTables ON --EnableAutomaticRotation false --DBClusterId 'pc-000000000000' --EncryptionKey '749c1df7-0000-0000-0000-000000000' --RoleArn 'acs:ram::140692600000:role/aliyunrdsinstanceencryptiondefaultrole'
